titleEn: Only as Loud as the Bell!

pages.text: "I WANT TO TALK FIRST!" Lulu shouted at dinner. The neck bell jingled wildly. Three cousins flinched and covered their ears.
Another shout at the cousin beside Lulu. "GIVE ME SOUP!" The cousin dropped the ladle. Soup spilled over the tablecloth. The table fell quiet.
Three cousins carried their bowls to the far end. Lulu's neighboring seats were empty. "Why is everyone leaving?"
Mom sat beside Lulu and served soup. "Your loud voice startled everyone." Lulu's ears drooped. "I was only talking..."
Mom touched the bell with a fingertip. Jingle! "At the table, only this loud. Louder than the bell is a loud voice. Only as loud as the bell!"
Lulu tried a whisper. "Could I... have soup?" Even the bell stayed still. The cousins brought their bowls back.
When Lulu whispered, the cousins whispered back. Laughter returned to that table end. Lulu's bell jingled just once.
After dinner, Mom took Lulu outside. "Here, a loud voice is fine!" With her forepaw on Lulu's shoulder, Lulu cupped both forepaws round the mouth and shouted toward the snowy hill. "YAHOO!"

Next morning, the cousins still slept softly. Lulu tiptoed up, holding the bell tight and matching its volume. "One, quieter than the bell at the table! Two, loud in the yard! Three, quieter if someone is startled!"
Mom sat Lulu on her knee and patted the back. A quiet voice brings everyone close. Lulu whispered in her ear. "Only as loud as the bell!"
